newsitem.title: EGYPT: Guard shot in hand at former Egypt minister's residence.
newsitem.headline: Guard shot in hand at former Egypt minister's residence.

text.p: A security guard was shot and wounded at the Cairo residence of a former Egyptian interior minister on Wednesday, an official statement said.
The guard was taken to hospital and treated for a broken hand after the shooting outside the residence of Al-Nabawi Ismail, who was interior minister from the late 1970s to the early 1980s.
The interior ministry statement said it was possible that the guard had been shot by his own gun or by a colleague by mistake. The guards were being questioned.
Earlier, police had said unidentified gunmen fired shots. But the interior ministry said eyewitnesses had not seen or heard any sign that the attack came from outside the compound.
